page.content:
Trade group of producers and presenters that co-presents the Tony Awards.

How The Broadway League connects

  • Event: Tony Awards — The Broadway League co-presents the Tony Awards.
  • Topic: Broadway — The Broadway League is the producers' and owners' trade group for Broadway.

What is The Broadway League?

The Broadway League is the producers' and theatre-owners' association that tracks grosses, runs audience research, and co-presents the Tony Awards with the American Theatre Wing.

Key threads lead to Tony Awards and Broadway.
